crossRefs.note: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?
Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David…
They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search, and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”
They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue, as they heard these things.
They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they…
“Come, see a man who told me everything that I did. Can this be the Christ?”
Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?
Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

people.name: Nathanael
people.line: Disciple of Jesus, from Cana in Galilee.

people.name: Nazareth
people.line: The hometown of Jesus in Galilee

people.name: Philip
people.line: One of the twelve apostles of Jesus

translations.web: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”
translations.bsb: “Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Nathanael asked. “Come and see,” said Philip.
translations.kjv: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
translations.asv: And Nathanael said unto him, Can any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
